question: For each offer department code in the 2012SU term with total units greater than 0, list the subject title, course number, department name, the dense rank over the offer department code, the course, course description, school name, program code, program title, category code, category title, four digit code, four digit title, and the minimum warehouse load date from the CIP table over each category code group for courses in department 6, and include a grand total of subjects per offer department code and a grand total for all courses in each school in the format (nulls for subject-specific fields, department name, total subjects, course-specific fields, school name, and total courses).
